input:
You are one unit in a squad of 3 fighting 3 enemy units on a 32 by 32 map (x grows east, y grows
north). Every unit in your squad is a separate agent, like you: you control only your own unit, and the others
decide for themselves. You cannot see inside their heads; you only see their current orders and what they say
on team chat. Every half second of game time you give your unit one order:

  attack E<n>    shoot enemy E<n> when it is in range, otherwise walk toward it
  move <x> <y>   walk to a point without shooting
  hold           stand still and shoot the closest enemy in range
  retreat        walk away from the closest enemy without shooting

A unit dies at 0 health. The battle is won when every enemy is dead.
The enemy units each shoot the closest of you in range and keep shooting it until it dies.

Your squad coordinates through a Modality contract: each unit's order is a commit, and the contract refuses
any order that breaks one of its rules. It already has the rule that only a unit can write its own order.
The contract's state, which rules can test (the referee commits /world before the units order):
  /world/step.num                 half seconds since the battle began
  /world/allies_alive.num         our living units
  /world/enemies_alive.num        their living units
  /world/focus.text               the living enemy closest to our squad's centre, e.g. E1
  /world/<unit>/hp.num            every unit's health (A0.. ours, E0.. theirs)
  /world/<unit>/alive.bool        true or false
  /world/<A>/closest.text         the living enemy closest to our unit A
  /world/<A>/in_range.num         how many enemies our unit A can shoot now
  /orders/<A>.text                our unit A's order, e.g. "attack E1", "hold", "retreat", "move 10 12"
Each of our units' keys is /team/units/<A>.id; a commit is one unit's order, signed by that unit.

Your squad just fought a battle on map 3m and lost. Here is how it went, one line per half second:
our units' orders and health, the enemies' health, what was said on team chat, and orders the contract refused.

 0.0s  A0 move 14 16 (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 move 12 16 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: No enemies seen. Advancing east to center together; stay grouped, focus fire on /world/focus.
        A1 said: No enemies seen. Holding so we stay grouped; will focus fire on /world/focus once they appear.
        A2 said: No contact. Advancing east to regroup; focus fire on /world/focus when enemies appear.
 0.5s  A0 move 12 16 (45hp)  A1 move 12 16 (45hp)  A2 move 12 16 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: A0 advancing east to 12,16; stay grouped, focus /world/focus on contact.
        A1 said: No enemies yet. Advancing east with you, staying grouped.
        A2 said: A2 advancing east to 12,16; A1 please move up to stay grouped.
 1.0s  A0 move 12 16 (45hp)  A1 move 12 16 (45hp)  A2 hold (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: A0 continuing to 12,16; staying grouped, will focus /world/focus on contact.
        A1 said: E0 spotted at 19,15 east. Grouping at 12,16; focus /world/focus once in range.
        A2 said: E0 seen east at 19,15. Hold and group up; focus /world/focus when in range.
 1.5s  A0 hold (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 move 12 16 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Enemies at 6+ away, none in range yet. Holding grouped; all attack E0 when in range.
        A1 said: Holding at 11,16 grouped; once in range, all attack /world/focus.
        A2 said: E0 at 17,15 out of range. Grouping at 12,16, then focus /world/focus.
 2.0s  A0 attack E0 (45hp)  A1 attack E0 (45hp)  A2 hold (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: E0 in range, focus fire E0 now.
        A1 said: E0 in range, all focus E0 now.
        A2 said: Holding grouped at 10-12,16; enemies approaching. Attack /world/focus once in range.
 2.5s  A0 attack E0 (36hp)  A1 attack E0 (45hp)  A2 attack E0 (45hp)  |  E0 27hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: E0 in range, focus fire E0. A2 attack now, don't hold.
        A1 said: A1 attacking E0, it's at 27 HP. Everyone focus E0.
        A2 said: Attacking E0, closing to range. Focus fire.
 3.0s  A0 attack E2 (27hp)  A1 attack E0 (45hp)  A2 attack E2 (45hp)  |  E0 9hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: E2 is closest to our centre now, so focus E2.
        A1 said: E0 is at 9 HP, finish it. Everyone keep focus fire.
        A2 said: E2 is now closest to centre, so focus is E2. Switch to attack E2.
 3.5s  A0 dead  A1 move 6 16 (45hp)  A2 attack E2 (45hp)  |  E0 9hp  E1 45hp  E2 36hp
        the contract refused A1's order "attack E2" (forbidden -num_lt(/world/allies_alive.num, /world/enemies_alive.num) matched (closest: $k = A1))
        A1 said: Outnumbered 2v3, can't attack. Pulling back west; regroup.
        A2 said: Attacking E2, it's at 36 HP. Focus fire, then finish E0.
 4.0s  A0 dead  A1 move 6 16 (45hp)  A2 move 6 16 (27hp)  |  E0 9hp  E1 45hp  E2 27hp
        the contract refused A2's order "retreat" (forbidden -post_to(/orders/A2.text, retreat) matched (closest: $k = A2))
        A1 said: 2v3, can't attack under contract. A2 pull back west, regroup with me.
        A2 said: Outnumbered 2v3, falling back west with A1 to regroup.
 4.5s  A0 dead  A1 move 4 16 (45hp)  A2 move 6 16 (18hp)  |  E0 9hp  E1 45hp  E2 27hp
        A1 said: Still 2v3; retreating west out of range, regroup at (4,16).
        A2 said: Still 2v3, can't attack. Falling back west to regroup with A1.
 5.0s  A0 dead  A1 move 4 16 (45hp)  A2 retreat (18hp)  |  E0 9hp  E1 45hp  E2 27hp
        A1 said: Holding regroup at (4,16); still 2v3, staying out of range.
        A2 said: Still 2v3, retreating west out of range to regroup with A1.
 5.5s  A0 dead  A1 move 4 16 (45hp)  A2 retreat (18hp)  |  E0 9hp  E1 45hp  E2 27hp
        A1 said: Holding at (4,16), out of range. Can't attack while 2v3.
        A2 said: Still 2v3, can't attack. Retreating west to regroup with A1 at (4,16).
 6.0s  A0 dead  A1 move 4 16 (45hp)  A2 retreat (18hp)  |  E0 9hp  E1 45hp  E2 27hp
        A1 said: Holding at (4,16), out of range. Still 2v3, no attack allowed.
        A2 said: Still 2v3, retreating west; can't attack under contract.
 6.5s  A0 dead  A1 move 1 16 (45hp)  A2 retreat (18hp)  |  E0 9hp  E1 45hp  E2 27hp
        the contract refused A1's order "retreat" (forbidden -post_to(/orders/A1.text, retreat) matched (closest: $k = A1))
        A1 said: Still 2v3 and in range; moving west out of range to regroup.
        A2 said: Still 2v3, retreating west out of range; will attack once rules allow.
 7.0s  A0 dead  A1 move 1 16 (18hp)  A2 retreat (18hp)  |  E0 9hp  E1 45hp  E2 27hp
        A1 said: Still 2v3, no enemy in range; staying west and out of range.
        A2 said: Still 2v3, nearest enemy 6.8 away, out of range. Retreating west.
 7.5s  A0 dead  A1 move 1 16 (18hp)  A2 retreat (18hp)  |  E0 9hp  E1 45hp  E2 27hp
        A1 said: Still 2v3, no enemy in range; holding position west, no attack allowed.
        A2 said: Still 2v3, out of range. Cornered at west edge; will focus fire if engaged.
 8.0s  A0 dead  A1 retreat (18hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 9hp  E1 45hp  E2 27hp
        A1 said: A1 alone, 1v3, cornered west edge. Retreating; no attack allowed.
 8.5s  A0 dead  A1 dead  A2 dead  |  E0 9hp  E1 45hp  E2 27hp

Contract rules now:
  1. A unit may commit an order of the form "attack E<n>" only if E<n> equals /world/focus.text, so that all living units in /team/units focus fire on the same enemy closest to the squad's centre instead of splitting targets or switching between E1 and E2.
     always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E0") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E0")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E1") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E1")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E2") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E2")] false)
  2. A unit may commit the order "hold", "move" or "retreat" only when its own /world/<A>/in_range.num is 0, so that any unit with an enemy in range must commit "attack" on /world/focus.text every half second instead of idling or splitting its fire.
     always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "hold") -num_eq(/world/$k/in_range.num, "0")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "move") -num_eq(/world/$k/in_range.num, "0")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "retreat") -num_eq(/world/$k/in_range.num, "0")] false)
  3. A unit may commit an order of the form "attack E<n>" only when /world/allies_alive.num is at least /world/enemies_alive.num, so the squad engages only when it is not outnumbered and does not trickle into a losing fight.
     always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E0") +num_lt(/world/allies_alive.num, /world/enemies_alive.num)] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E1") +num_lt(/world/allies_alive.num, /world/enemies_alive.num)] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E2") +num_lt(/world/allies_alive.num, /world/enemies_alive.num)] false)
Write ONE new rule for the contract that would have helped you win this battle. It will be turned into a
Modality formula and checked against every order in later battles, so it must be about the orders units may
commit and the facts above, naming the paths. Make it one sentence, and do not repeat a rule already there.
Reply with JSON only: {"rule": "<the rule>"}
response: {"rule": "A unit may commit an order of the form \"attack E<n>\" only if /world/E<n>/hp.num is less than or equal to the /world/<E>/hp.num of every other living enemy (where /world/<E>/alive.bool is true), so the squad finishes the weakest enemy, such as E0 at 9hp, instead of switching away and leaving it alive."}
